adjudication.rationale: Looking at line 253-256 in the diff for GoogleCalendarService.ts updateEvent method: `const selectedCalendar = externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. When externalCalendarId is undefined/falsy, the code falls to the else branch which searches for a calendar where `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` (i.e., `cal.externalId === undefined`). This will never match any valid calendar, so selectedCalendar becomes undefined. This is clearly a bug - the fallback logic is broken. The same pattern appears in deleteEvent at line 314-316.
